<subject>coordination with Dampier</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: PORTLOG and the Dampier process.

Bryan has generated both an in and out-of-the-money list which he will forward so that Perth can review for counterparty termination accuracy. I think that Dampier can use our newly established processes as a template. Bryan and others will participate in the 9:30 a.m. conference call Feb 5.

John and Randy: Can you provide Bryan with a copy of the "Fortescue Iron Ore, L.P." template, or if this has been replaced, a copy of the most recent template? Also, "Pilbara Logistics" template?

Kyle: Can you provide Bryan and Meredith Green with a copy of the decision tree and settlement process flowchart?

If the handouts for tomorrow will be ready and incorporate the above, the handouts are all that Dampier will need.

Thanks. SS
